english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for yielding partway to someone’s demands or requests.
Use 讓步 when the compromise means giving up something or making a one-sided concession.

examples.english: This time we both need to make a concession before we can reach a deal.
examples.traditional: 今次我哋都要作出讓步，先至傾得成。
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 ngo5 dei6 dou1 jiu3 zok3 ceot1 joeng6 bou6 sin1 zi3 king1 dak1 seng4

examples.english: They refused to compromise and insisted on following the original plan.
examples.traditional: 佢唔肯讓步，話一定要照原定計劃做。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 m4 hang2 joeng6 bou6 waa6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 ziu3 jyun4 ding6 gai3 waak6 zou6
